text:
Maya Park: Heads up — nightly e2e perf job failed baseline check for p99 latency on longseq. Gate flipped red at ~02:12 UTC. Not sure if this is flaky or a real regression. Can someone triage?
Jun Li: On it. Which pipeline/job id?
Maya Park: pipeline: e2e-longseq-nightly, build: 2024.11.23-504, job id 87654321. The diff vs baseline shows p99 +38ms and throughput -4%.
Omar Rodriguez: pinging @Jun. Any recent infra changes? autoscaler tweaks yesterday?
Jun Li: Nothing in autoscaler for longseq. I see one ML change merged yesterday from @Priya that touched kv-cache eviction thresholds in runtime.
Priya Sharma: Yup that was a small tweak — tightened KV eviction to save memory under high-concurrency. It passed unit tests and local perf. Could affect warmup behavior.
Maya Park: Stack trace/log snippet from the job (trimmed):
```
2024-11-23T02:11:58Z INFO e2e-runner: start batch 42 seq_len=8192
2024-11-23T02:12:10Z WARN runtime.kv: cache-miss-rate=0.42
2024-11-23T02:12:18Z WARN runtime.latency: p99=412ms (baseline 374ms)
```
Jun Li: That cache-miss-rate looks high. If eviction is too aggressive we lose KV warmup and p99 will jump. Can someone run a quick ablation: revert eviction change on a canary?
Omar Rodriguez: I can queue a rerun with the previous runtime artifact to compare. Want bisect or just single rerun?
Maya Park: Let's do quick compare first: rerun job with last-known-good artifact (2024.11.22-298) and same workload. If that restores baseline we can bisect next.
Jun Li: Agreed. Omar, can you trigger a rerun with artifact 298 on the same cluster?
Omar Rodriguez: Triggering now. Using curl to post to our e2e-runner service:
```bash
curl -X POST https://ci.internal/retry -d '{"job_id":87654321,"artifact":"2024.11.22-298"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN'
```
build-bot: Rerun queued by Omar Rodriguez — new run id 87654321-rc1. Estimated 10m to complete.
Maya Park: Thanks. Also adding @Priya to keep looped in. If this is it we may need a targeted fix (less aggressive eviction) or better warmup caching for long sequences.
Priya Sharma: I'll prepare a small rollback PR just in case. Also can add an experimental flag to tune eviction per workload.
ci-bot: Rerun 87654321-rc1 started at 02:22 UTC. Logs streaming: https://ci.internal/logs/87654321-rc1
Jun Li: Quick note — if rc1 shows improvement, we should run rc2 with only the eviction change to confirm causality, then open a bisect request to narrow commit.
Omar Rodriguez: rc1 completed: summary -> p99=376ms, throughput delta = +0.5% vs baseline.
build-bot: Rerun 87654321-rc1 finished. Result: PASS (baseline within SLAs).
Maya Park: Good sign — looks like the eviction tweak is the likely culprit. Priya, feel free to land rollback or a tuned config. We'll follow up with a formal bisect later to be safe.
Priya Sharma: Landing rollback PR now: #2049. Will also add a quick perf test to catch this class of regression.
Jun Li: Thanks everyone. I'll mark the nightly gate as investigated and close the incident if no further flaps. :white_check_mark:
Maya Park: Closing loop — thanks Omar for rerun and @Priya for fast rollback. Will add notes in the perf runbook about KV eviction sensitivity for longseq workloads. :memo:
